import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 510;
    static int n, m, mod;
    static int[][] C = new int[N][N];
    static Pair[][] dp = new Pair[N][N];

    static class Pair {
        long fi, se;

        Pair(long fi, long se) {
            this.fi = fi;
            this.se = se;
        }

        Pair add(Pair b) {
            return new Pair(add((int) this.fi, (int) b.fi), add((int) this.se, (int) b.se));
        }

        Pair multiply(Pair b) {
            long newFi = (this.fi * b.fi) % mod;
            long newSe = (this.fi * b.se + this.se * b.fi) % mod;
            return new Pair(newFi, newSe);
        }
    }

    static int add(int a, int b) {
        return a + b >= mod ? a + b - mod : a + b;
    }

    static int s1(int l, int r) {
        return (l + r) * (r - l + 1) / 2;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        mod = sc.nextInt();

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            C[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                C[i][j] = add(C[i - 1][j], C[i - 1][j - 1]);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                dp[i][j] = new Pair(0, 0);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            dp[i][0] = new Pair(1, 0);
            for (int j = 1; j <= i && j <= m; j++) {
                if (i != j) {
                    for (int k = 1; k <= i; k++) {
                        Pair temp = dp[k - 1][k - 1].multiply(dp[i - k][j - k + 1]).multiply(new Pair(C[j][k - 1], 0));
                        dp[i][j] = dp[i][j].add(temp);
                    }
                } else {
                    for (int k = 1; k <= i; k++) {
                        Pair temp = dp[k - 1][k - 1].multiply(dp[i - k][i - k])
                                .multiply(new Pair(C[i - 1][k - 1], 0))
                                .multiply(new Pair(i + 1, k * k - s1(1, k) + s1(k + 1, i) - k * (i - k)), 1));
                        dp[i][j] = dp[i][j].add(temp);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(dp[n][m].se);
        sc.close();
    }
}
